headline: Exchanges Post A $6.616 Billion Outflow As Coins Leave Venues
narrative: Crypto exchanges posted a 24-hour net outflow of $6.616 billion, equal to 2.6 percent of reserves. That pipe is accumulation: coins left trading venues instead of arriving on them for sale. Bitcoin traded near 77k, while options skew at 9.85 showed downside heavily bid into the Oct. 31 expiry, puts struck at 70k and calls at 84k.
author: jordan
